about: Trees found while researching Ayutthaya that are not published. Source for most: the Ministry of Culture Heritage Trees of the Land lists (2017, 2018, 2019) as reproduced in th.wikipedia.

leads.name: Bodhi on the chedi, Wat Na Phra Meru
leads.source: OSM node 14096727338 'ต้นโพธิ์ปรกเจดีย์' (natural=tree)
leads.note: A bodhi crowning one of the three brick chedis behind the ordination hall of Wat Na Phra Meru (the temple that survived the 1767 sack), called a natural sculpture by the Ayutthaya provincial site (search summary only; page 404). No age. lifecheck RECENT hit at the spot was a Tecoma, not the tree, so alive not shown. Needs a dated photo of the tree and an age or measurement; lead: no second source or alive evidence yet.
